decisions_locked.rationale: Consolidating 4 single-function micro-files into runPublisherFlow.ts reduces import bloat, keeps the module cohesive and easily maintainable at 268 lines (under the 500-line limit), and unifies flow orchestration.

Placing state authority in an in-memory reactive store prevents file-based race conditions and optimistic concurrency clobbering across concurrent scheduler, observer, publisher, and control panel operations.
